findings: Upper-lash fibre radius is reduced to 54 percent of r1098 while preserving all 91 root centroids per eye.
Deterministic length variation, temporal fan, curl and paired micro-clumping reduce the previous uniform comb silhouette.

The lashes remain somewhat dense at macro range, but their silhouette is finer and less mechanically parallel.
The medial canthus still exposes slab-like inner-wall geometry in oblique view and is the next eye-area blocker.
